frozen_before: any dev metric of any M1 predictor; WO-012's train-only pilot had been seen, so this takes the stricter reading

definitions.decided_by: owner, 2026-11-01: ET-M1-1 keeps the stricter reading
definitions.stream_rmse: root mean square over all dev windows and all coordinates of the stream, at one horizon, in the stream's own units
definitions.rule: For each required stream separately, at every horizon 1 to 10, learned RMSE is at least 20% below the lowest baseline RMSE for that stream and horizon.

streams_excluded.target_position: it never moves within an episode

baselines: linear: extrapolation from the last two states
nominal: the nominal model inside the learned predictor, with no residual
